coordinateSource: OpenStreetMap healthcare POIs via cached Photon queries and a bounded Overpass extract. Coordinates can represent building/site centroids.
matching: Healthcare POI in Bengaluru bounds; distinctive-name token agreement >=75% or normalized spelling similarity >=88%. Available postcode conflicts and facility-type conflicts rejected. Address token agreement ranks candidates; close competing scores excluded. All matches are inferred and need verification.
unresolved: Unmatched records retained separately. No address/locality centroid guesses.
